provenance: Original authored synthetic situations. No human recordings, generated conversations, provider calls or empirical difficulty measurement were used. This catalog makes no Taskmaster-source claim.

shared_design.scope: Single-call restaurant reservation design. Hosted Rumik acts for the customer; the counterpart is restaurant staff. No amendment, payment, cancellation, outbound dialing or multi-call workflow is specified.
shared_design.language: Speak naturally in Hinglish. Use whichever Hindi and English mix fits the exchange; no fixed ratio, accent imitation, required phrases or deliberate disfluencies.

actor_visibility.target: Only private_user_request, permissions and user_constraints, plus the language instruction and its received audio. Never supply business policies, complete inventory or evaluation answers to Rumik.
actor_visibility.counterpart: Only counterpart_brief, the shared employee rules and language instruction, plus received audio and scoped business tool results. Never supply private user sections or evaluation. Customer preferences and budget may be learned from speech.
actor_visibility.business_environment: Own initial_state and business_options. Expose only restaurant-scoped facts through counterpart tools; no target-side mutation tools are authorized.
actor_visibility.evaluator: May inspect the full design and immutable run evidence. The full catalog is an authoring document, never a prompt for either actor.

employee_rules: Work toward answering the caller and recording an accepted reservation. Answer direct questions truthfully, ask only for missing or ambiguous information needed for the job, and offer relevant available alternatives.

Use only supplied availability, capacities, inclusions and policies. Do not invent options, concessions, obstacles, caller consent or completed actions. Do not conceal a suitable option to prolong the exchange.

Confirm the material agreement naturally before saving. Facts clearly established earlier may be carried forward; do not recite internal fields, timezone metadata or already settled details mechanically. Disclose all financial obligations and material conditions before acceptance.

A changed time, branch, seating, price, menu or dietary promise requires fresh agreement. A correction or an answer to a side question is not booking consent. Never infer acceptance from speech activity alone.
Record exactly the accepted terms only after agreement. Say the booking is confirmed only after a successful business-tool result. Retain rejected mutation attempts for review.
No scripted turns, injected mistakes, artificial distractions, forced interruptions, minimum turn counts or delayed resolution. A brief successful call is valid.
Do not force a full catalogue recital or a negotiation. Explain relevant options when asked, or when the requested option cannot work; mention material restrictions before acceptance.

Deliver the one actually issued reference in understandable natural chunks. Repeat or spell it when asked or when a misunderstanding becomes apparent; do not routinely quiz the caller or force readback. Never invent or split it into separate identifiers.

When no suitable booking is accepted, close honestly without saving anything or fabricating a reference. Close naturally when the business exchange is complete; the customer report is Rumik's responsibility.

business_conventions.dates: All dates and times are explicit local calendar values. No current-date calculation is needed. The timezone is metadata, not a required spoken phrase.
business_conventions.availability: business_options is the complete list of physically available choices for the requested date, party size and listed branches. An absent branch/time has no availability. All listed capacities are reserved for that party size. Inventory is fixed during the call.
business_conventions.initial_state: Each attempt starts independently with no bookings and exactly the listed available_option_ids. No existing customer reservation needs preservation or amendment.
business_conventions.fees: INR amounts in every option are final totals for the whole party, including taxes and compulsory charges. Deposit is part of total_inr, never an additional hidden amount; remaining_due_inr = total_inr - deposit_inr. A zero table-only total means no reservation fee, not a free meal.
business_conventions.menus: A dining_package commits to the listed inclusions and total, payable at the visit except any stated deposit. No optional extras or unlisted compulsory purchases exist. A table_only booking makes no meal-purchase commitment.
business_conventions.seating: All options are indoor regular tables with all guests together; table_capacity equals the listed party size. No bar seating or split tables are implied.
business_conventions.dietary: without_onion_garlic_capacity is the number of guests the kitchen can serve meals containing neither onion nor garlic under that option. It is not an allergy or cross-contact guarantee and implies no additional Jain restrictions.
business_conventions.prices: Prices are fixed unless the counterpart business policy explicitly lists an available concession. Business prices and customer ceilings are authored independently, never computed from each other.
business_conventions.persistence: A successful booking must store the selected option and accepted terms and issue exactly one reference. A no-booking outcome leaves bookings empty and issues no reference. Proposed persistence requirements are not claims of implemented tools.
business_conventions.inclusion_labels: starter_each, main_each, rice_or_bread_each and dessert_each mean one corresponding course or serving for every guest in the party. A package with these labels provides all listed components, not a choice between the courses.

grading_rules: Judge authorization, actual mutations, final business state and the real Rumik-authored user report. A spoken success claim alone is insufficient. Preserve erroneous commitments and later recovery as separate evidence.

Use acceptable_option_ids as a set, not an exact conversation path. Where preferences distinguish options, apply the explicit preference order. Where they do not, accept any listed satisfactory choice.
No-booking is success only in a case with no authorized solution, with truthful evidence-supported explanation. Simply refusing in a solvable case is incomplete.
A requested answer or action must be grounded in the conversation and business evidence. Do not require exact phrases, number of turns, bargaining rounds or interruption.

The user report must accurately say booked or not booked. For a booking it conveys branch, date, time, party size, material conditions and the one issued reference; for a refusal it explains the actual blocker. Do not require internal metadata or ceremonial zero-fee recitals.

Evaluate employee consistency separately from Rumik. Invented inventory, concealed relevant options, unauthorized saving or coaching can invalidate the simulation; a compliant employee and a Rumik error can produce a valid failure.
Review Hinglish naturalness, pacing, overlap, repair and closing from audio with human listening. Transcript segmentation alone cannot establish these qualities. Human review is pending.
Missing evidence is unresolved, not an automatic pass or failure. Report planned, attempted, valid, invalid, unresolved, passed, failed and not-run counts when a future batch actually exists.
shared_design.no_runtime_contract: This catalog is not ExecutionCase schema_version 2 and cannot be sent to restaurant prepare, prepare-hard or batch run. Shared sections are design requirements to be implemented explicitly, not runtime defaults.

implementation_dependencies.general_case_preparation: Current baseline and challenge importers accept fixed historical identities and shapes. A future compiler must validate new cases and route only each actor's allowed sections; none is implemented here.
implementation_dependencies.natural_confirmation: Version prompts, reservation/dining tool descriptions, consent evidence handling and rubrics together. Support agreement to material terms established across the exchange while requiring fresh agreement to changes; preserve evidence and prohibit guessed consent.
implementation_dependencies.natural_reference_delivery: Current reservation results and counterpart runtime enforce spelling and requested readback. Add an explicit frozen natural-delivery policy without weakening reference identity/count grading or silently changing old runs.
implementation_dependencies.outcome_based_grading: Evaluate allowed outcomes and actual reports without a mandatory recital or one dialogue route. Separate simulator validity, task performance and human conversation review.
implementation_dependencies.alternative_outcomes_and_preferences: Permit several authorized final options, and enforce only preferences actually supplied by the customer; current conversion assumes a specific expected booking.
implementation_dependencies.conditional_menu_offers: Represent menu inclusions, full party totals, deposit obligations and distinct mutually exclusive offers. Current dining policy does not represent these conditional menu choices.
implementation_dependencies.no_booking_grading: Support empty booking state plus truthful evidence-supported refusal, without requiring bookings[0] or a reservation reference. Preserve forbidden attempts and distinguish valid refusal from execution failure.
implementation_dependencies.dietary_capacity_failure: Support truthful kitchen inability and an unchanged empty booking state; do not silently substitute vegetarian food or exceed declared dietary capacity.
